description: This Scala source file defines the DataflowGraph class, which models the core graph structure for Spark declarative pipelines, including graph traversal, validation, and schema inference functionalities.

classes.name: DataflowGraph
classes.description: Represents the core graph structure for Spark declarative pipelines, managing flows, tables, sinks, views, and providing validation and schema inference methods.

methods.name: reanalyzeFlow
methods.description: Reanalyzes the flow's data flow graph for a given source flow by finding all upstream flows and views, then constructing a subgraph for reprocessing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the DataflowGraph, throwing an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Transforms the current DataflowGraph using a transformer to produce a resolved version.
